description: Cross-cutting review routes for every path changed between two pinned Gecko ESR trees. A path can match multiple routes; unmatched paths remain in the complete general-upstream inventory.

routes.description: Configure, mozbuild, Rust workspace, and runtime packaging behavior that can change the selected Desktop Embedder graph.
Parent/child startup, process bootstrap, IPC, launcher, mozglue, and native sandbox contracts.
Desktop widget, accessibility, platform integration, and XPCOM host lifecycle behavior.
Privileged modules and services directly consumed by Runtime, Session, View, or Delegate adapters.
BrowsingContext/Fission, docshell, principal, navigation, history, and network behavior retained by every profile.
The Gecko core closure that supplies general Web behavior rather than product presentation.
Review the disabled Web device, identity, payment and XR closures and their shared binding/IPC/native consumers without reintroducing product exposure.
Review retained WebRTC, media capture, WebGPU and local extensions alongside the excluded ML, observability and XR closures; preserve the accepted product capability set.
WebDriver BiDi, Marionette, Remote Agent and future DevTools changes that can alter automation reach, privileged access or extension mutation surfaces.
Vendored native/Rust code and dependency-lock changes requiring licensing, security, and graph review.
Review PDF.js conversion/principals/ranges/sandbox/forms/save and printing snapshots/settings/native host lifecycles without adding online services or AI.
